description: NSTA’s production page documents access to Petroleum Production Reporting System data, including field production points, filtered queries and related dashboards. It explains how to select reporting units through the open-data service. The provider is North Sea Transition Authority. Coverage: Coverage is the UK continental shelf. The describing page does not establish one observation period, reporting interval or measurement resolution for every linked layer. Access: NSTA describes public data-query and open-data access. Reporting login is for submitting returns, not evidence that all public reading requires an account. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The individual dataset metadata, data quality and current reporting coverage were not inspected. For simulation it supplies a route to production inputs and field-level operating histories. Related resources: data-nsta-ukcs-offshore-infrastructure covers physical assets. Its description does not cover the separate PPRS production observations.
